Seeing only outbox occurs when the account has never signed in to the server.

Did you press 'Later' during the account import, instead of tapping each account name and following the oauth sign-in flow. See screen shot.

To resolve, navigate to

  1. Settings > account name > fetching mail > incoming server
  2. Tap next
  3. Tap Sign-in with [provider] button if displayed ⋆.

⋆ Follow your mail providers oAuth 2.0 sign-in steps and grant TB permissions on your account.
